གནས་པའི: dwelling, of one who dwells (gnas pa 'to dwell, remain' + -'i 'of'): sa la gnas pa'i 'dwelling on the levels'
འཛུམ་པའི: smiling, of a smile ('dzum 'smile' + -pa + -'i 'of'): 'dzum pa'i mdangs 'a smiling radiance'
མཁའ་འགྲོ: sky-goer, ḍākinī (mkha' 'sky' + 'gro 'go'; also written mkha' 'gro ma, with the feminine -ma)
འཁྲིལ: to wind about, to embrace ('khril): 'khril zhing 'embracing, and'
མཛད: to make, to do (mdzad, the respectful word for 'do'): gar mdzad 'make a dance'
དབང་བའི: of having power, having power over (dbang ba 'to have power' + -'i 'of'): tshe la dbang ba'i 'having power over life'
དཔེ་བྱད: the minor marks, the eighty lesser signs of a buddha's body (dpe byad)
ལྡན་བ: having, endowed with (ldan ba, this print's spelling of ldan pa)
ལྷུན་གྱིས་གྲུབ་པའི: of the spontaneously present, of what is present of itself (lhun gyis 'of itself, spontaneously' + grub pa 'be accomplished, be present' + -'i 'of')
ཁྲོ་འཛུམ: wrathful and smiling, a face both at once (khro 'wrath' + 'dzum 'smile')
འཛིན་པས: by holding, holding ('dzin 'hold' + -pa + -s 'by'): thod khrag 'dzin pas 'holding the skull of blood'
རོལ་དུ: at the side of, round about (rol 'side' + -du 'at'): rnams kyi rol du 'round them'; the usual word is phyi rol 'outside', and the sense is taken from the context
མཁའ་འགྲོ་མའི: of sky-goer women, of ḍākinīs (mkha' 'gro ma + -'i 'of')
བཅུའི: of ten (bcu 'ten' + -'i 'of'): gnas bcu'i 'of the ten places'
ཉི་ཤུ་རྩ་བཞིའི: of twenty-four (nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'twenty-four' + -'i 'of'): the twenty-four lands, sacred sites of the tantras
དཔའ་བོ: hero (dpa' bo; Sanskrit vīra): in the tantras the male companions of the sky-goer women
དཔའ་མོ: heroine (dpa' mo, the feminine of dpa' bo 'hero'): in the tantras a female companion of the sky-goers
གིང: ging, a class of wild dancing attendants in the retinue of the wrathful deities (ging; the word is left untranslated)
ཆོས་སྐྱོང་བའི: of those who protect the teaching (chos 'teaching' + skyong ba 'to protect' + -'i 'of')
རུས་པའི: of bone, made of bone (rus pa 'bone' + -'i 'of')
ཐོད་རྔ: skull drum (thod 'skull' + rnga 'drum'), a small double-headed drum
ཞིང་ལྤགས: perhaps a flayed skin, the skin of a slain enemy (zhing 'field', in tantric speech the body of an enemy, + lpags 'skin'); the sense is not sure
མི་གསུར: burnt offering of human flesh, taken so (mi 'human' + gsur 'burnt offering of flour and food, for its smoke'); the sense is partly guessed
བྱེ་བྲག: kind, sort, variety (bye brag): rol mo'i bye brag 'kinds of music'
ཁམས: realm, world, element (khams): 'jig rten gyi khams 'the realms of the world'
ཁེངས་པ: filled, full (khengs pa, the intransitive 'to be full'; the transitive 'to fill' is 'gengs)
ཤིག་ཤིག: shaking (shig shig), a doubled word of motion; the sense is approximate
ཡོམ་ཡོམ: swaying (yom yom), a doubled word of motion; the sense is approximate
འགུལ་འགུལ་དུ: quiveringly, in a quivering manner ('gul 'gul 'quiver', doubled, + -du 'in the manner of')
འགས་པ: splitting, cracking ('gas pa 'to split, crack'): mgo 'gas pa tsam 'as much as splits the head'
འདིར་བ: perhaps booming, roaring, taken as ldir ba ('dir is the print's spelling; 'dir also means 'here'); the sense is a guess
སྣ་ཚོགས: various, of many kinds (sna tshogs): gar sna tshogs 'dances of many kinds'
བྱེད: to do, doing (byed, the present stem; past byas): gar sna tshogs byed 'doing dances of many kinds'
དམ་ཚིག་ཅན: one who has the commitment, keeper of vows (dam tshig 'commitment, vow' + can 'having'): one who holds the vows of tantric practice
བཅད་དུ: to cut, to impose (bcad, the past stem of gcod 'cut', + -du 'to'): chad pa bcad du 'ong 'come to impose punishment'
ལྷན་ཅིག་སྐྱེས་པའི: of the coemergent, born together (lhan cig 'together' + skyes pa 'born' + -'i 'of'; Sanskrit sahaja): the wisdom born together with the mind itself
མཚོན་སྐུད: taken as coloured thread, for tshon skud (tshon 'colour, dye' + skud 'thread'); mtshon itself is 'weapon, sign'; the sense is taken from the context
སྒྲིལ་མ: twisted, rolled up (sgril 'to roll, to wind' + -ma)
ཁྲ་ཤིག་ཤིག་པ: mottled and quivering (khra 'mottled, many-coloured' + shig shig 'quivering' + -pa); the sense is approximate
མེར་མེར་བ: flickering, as flames do (mer mer ba); the sense is approximate
ཕྱམ་ཕྱམ་པ: perhaps gleaming (phyam phyam pa); the sense is not sure
ཉམ་ང་བ: fearsome, dreadful (nyam nga ba): bkrag la nyam nga ba 'lustrous and fearsome'
རིགས་འཛིན: knowledge-holder (rigs 'dzin, this print's spelling of rig 'dzin)
གཙོ་བོ: chief, principal one (gtso bo): gtso bo lnga 'the five chiefs'
ཐད: straight at, right toward (thad): thad snying kar 'straight at the heart'
སྙིང་ཀར: at the heart, in the heart (snying ka 'heart' + -r 'at')
ལྔ་ལྡན: having five (lnga 'five' + ldan 'have'), short for lnga dang ldan pa: 'od kha dog lnga ldan 'light having five colours'
ལྡིར་བ: roaring, booming (ldir ba, from ldir 'to boom, roar'): ldir ba tsam 'as much as roaring'
སྒྲ་གྲགས: sound, noise, din (sgra 'sound' + grags 'to sound, be heard'): sgra grags la ldir che ba 'loud of sound and great in booming'
འུར་སྒྲ: din, roar ('ur sgra 'a sound of roaring')
བསོ་སྒྲ: perhaps a roar, another cry of the kind (bso sgra); the word bso is not known, and the sense is not sure
བཅས: together with (bcas, the short form of bcas pa): dang bcas nas 'together with … and then'
རང་དུ: as its own, as itself (rang 'self' + -du 'as'): rig pa'i rang du 'as awareness itself'
གླེན་ལྐུགས: dull and dumb, stupid and mute (glen 'stupid' + lkugs 'dumb')
བཀོལ་གཅོད: taken as being worked and slaughtered (bkol, past of 'khol 'to put to work', + gcod 'to cut'); the sense is partly guessed
འདས་པ: gone beyond, passed ('das, the past stem of 'da' 'to pass beyond', + -pa): mtha' las 'das pa 'gone beyond the limit, boundless'
མདུན: perhaps longing, taken as 'dun pa in mdun brtse gcig tu (mdun itself is 'front'); the sense is not sure
བརྩེ་གཅིག་ཏུ: perhaps one-pointedly, taken for rtse gcig tu (brtse itself is 'love' + gcig 'one' + tu); kept as printed, and the sense is not sure
ཁྱེད: you (khyed), the politer word, also used for more than one: khyed rnams 'you all'
མཁྱེན: to know, to take heed (mkhyen, the respectful word for 'know'): khyed rnams mkhyen 'you all know, take heed'
བསགས་པ: gathered (bsags pa, bsags the past stem of gsog 'gather'): tshogs ma bsags pa 'who has not gathered the accumulations'
དུས་གསུམ: the three times, past, present and future (dus 'time' + gsum 'three')
བདེ་གཤེགས: sugata, one gone to bliss, a buddha (bde gshegs, short for bde bar gshegs pa)
དེ་ཙམ: so many, so much (de 'that' + tsam 'as much'): de tsam cig gi 'of so many'
བཟུང: held, seized (bzung, the past stem of 'dzin 'hold': 'dzin / bzung / gzung / zung): bzung yang ma zin pa 'held, yet not caught'
འདྲ་བ: like, resembling ('dra ba): bdag 'dra ba 'one like me'
ཨ་ཙ་མ་ར: alas! a cry of dismay (a tsa ma ra, kept as printed; the usual cry is a tsa ma re)
མན་ཆད: from … downward, from then on (man chad): 'di man chad 'from this on'
བཏང་ཅིག: let go! (btang, the past stem of gtong 'let go', + cig, which marks a command; the imperative stem proper is thong); ma btang cig 'do not let go'
བཟུང་ཅིག: hold! (bzung, the past stem of 'dzin 'hold', + cig, which marks a command); the imperative stem proper is zung
ཞིང་དུ: to the realm, into the field (zhing 'realm, buddha-field' + -du 'to')
ཁོན: uncertain, kept as printed; perhaps a slip for kho na 'only, very' or khong nas 'from within'; khon itself is 'grudge, resentment', which gives no sense here; read, as a guess, 'right away'
དྲང་དུ: to lead (drang, the future stem of 'dren 'lead', + -du 'to'): drang du gsol 'I pray that you lead'
དགོངས་སུ: to heed, into the mind (dgongs, the respectful 'think', + -su 'into'): dgongs su gsol 'I pray, think of me'
ཆེན་པོས: by the great (chen po 'great' + -s 'by'): brtse ba chen pos 'by great love'
ལྷན་སྐྱེས: coemergent, born together (lhan skyes, short for lhan cig skyes pa)
དེ་རུ: to that, there (de 'that' + -ru 'to', a form of the particle la used, like -r, after a vowel)
སྐྱེ་བར: to be born, in being born (skye ba 'to be born' + -r): skye bar the tshom med 'there is no doubt of being born'
དགེ་བའི་བཤེས་གཉེན: spiritual friend, teacher of virtue (dge ba 'virtue' + bshes gnyen 'friend'; Sanskrit kalyāṇamitra)
ཤ་སྟག་གོ: nothing but, all without exception (sha stag + the sentence-ending -go)
ངན: bad, evil (ngan): bag chags ngan 'bad habitual tendencies'
ཡན་ཆད: from … upward, and everything above (yan chad): de yan chad 'that and all above it'
འཕྲོད་པ: meeting, recognition ('phrod 'to meet' + -pa): ngo 'phrod pa 'the recognition'
ཐལ་ལོ: perhaps it is finished, a closing word (thal 'to pass through, to have gone by' + the sentence-ending -lo); the sense is not sure
ཨྠྀི: iti, 'thus', the Sanskrit word that closes a text, written as one stacked sign (i-thi)
རྒྱ: seal (rgya; Sanskrit mudrā): rgya rgya rgya 'seal, seal, seal', the threefold seal at the end of a treasure text
